name: Delivery Receipt Type 2 Code
definition: Specifies how the transaction is to be settled.

FREE.name: Separate Settlement
FREE.definition: Settlement of the financial instrument and cash is separate.

APMT.name: Against Payment Settlement
APMT.definition: Settlement of the financial instrument and cash takes place in a delivery versus payment (DVP) environment, that is, through an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD) or Central Securities Depository (CSD).
